recommendations.title: Keep a note from the first word typed, whatever happens next
recommendations.change: A note exists as soon as someone starts typing it. Leaving the app, losing the connection, or pressing Done with no signal should never leave the list without it; at worst it is marked as not yet synced.

user_voice.quote: my note is gone. I typed all that out for nothing
I wrote that whole thing on the train for nothing

recommendations.rationale: Two blockers, two personas, two builds, two different interruptions -- backgrounding and an offline save -- with the same result: typed text gone. They have different fingerprints because they happen on different actions, but from the people quoted they are one experience, and one change (keep a local draft from the first keystroke) plausibly addresses both.
open_questions: Nobody has re-run the backgrounding case on build b7e9f01; time-starved-parent x note-capture-offline is an empty cell in the coverage matrix and would test both at once.

recommendations.title: Say whether a note was saved, on screen and out loud
recommendations.change: After Done, the person is told one of two things -- saved, or not saved and why -- and the message is both visible and spoken by VoiceOver. Staying on the same screen with nothing said is never the outcome.

user_voice.quote: I have no idea if any of this is saved
it did not read anything out. no idea if that saved

recommendations.rationale: The only defect found by both personas, on both builds, by sight and by ear. Without it the people quoted cannot tell R-001's failure from success, which is why they each gave up rather than retrying.
